description: Register a new domain on the account. Check availability first with impreza_domain_check. This raises an invoice for the registration — settle it with impreza_pay_invoice (top up first with impreza_topup if the balance is short). Nameservers default to Impreza DNS, so you can manage records right away with impreza_add_dns_record. If confirm_token is absent from this connection's input schema, use a connection that exposes it or a supported customer-portal flow. A quote or confirmation request is not completion. COSTS MONEY — takes two calls: the first is a QUOTE that charges nothing and returns the price plus a confirm_token, the second repeats the same arguments plus confirm_token and buys. Purchases also count against a daily spend ceiling on the credential.

domain.description: Domain to register, e.g. "example.com". Must be available.

nameservers.description: Optional custom nameservers. Omit to use Impreza DNS (recommended — required for the DNS tools to work).

name: impreza_register_domain
title: Register domain
